body: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production game character basecolor UV texture atlas, not character concept art. Edit target: the supplied original Lu Bu body texture atlas, 512x512 square. Primary request: recolor ONLY the existing pixels/material regions into SILVER-WHITE ARMOR and ICE-BLUE CLOTH. This image will replace the base color on the EXACT SAME 3D model and UV coordinates. Preserve the texture layout with absolute precision: every UV island, border, seam, edge, engraving, rivet, contour, skin patch, eye, hair, and item must stay at the exact same relative pixel coordinates; no redrawing shapes, no packing or rearranging islands, no moving features, no changed margins, no cropping, no rotation, no mirroring. Treat this as carefully masked color grading of the original atlas. Existing gold/bronze armor plate surfaces and trim become pale cold silver steel, retaining the exact original shading/highlights/ornament outlines and depth; original black iron recesses become dark blue-gray steel with adequate contrast. Existing saturated red fabrics, shoulder drapery at upper right, red cloth bands, and red inset details become clear ICE BLUE fabric and slightly darker blue seams. Do not alter the human face at left, the eye island, skin patches or fingers on the right, or black hair islands. Skin remains natural warm human skin. Retain original fine detail rather than inventing new ornamentation. Preserve all engraved dragon motifs and seams in situ. Opaque color texture throughout, including unused pixels; no transparency or background removal. Same square aspect ratio; output 512x512 if supported, otherwise keep exact normalized coordinates at square higher resolution. Output ONLY the flat texture atlas with no 3D render, no human silhouette, no labels, no UV wire overlay, no frame, no text.
weapon: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production basecolor UV texture atlas for Lu Bu's halberd (weapon), not a weapon illustration. Edit target: supplied original weapon texture, 256x512 portrait aspect 1:2. Primary request: make a SILVER-WHITE and ICE-BLUE variant matching the character's silver armor and ice blue cloth. Change colors ONLY while keeping every existing texture island, contour, engraved swirl, blade shape, rod segment, edge and seam at precisely the same NORMALIZED XY positions as the original. This texture maps to an existing 3D weapon; any shifted layout makes the file unusable. Preserve all original shapes and shading closely; no new decorations, no repainting contours, no cutting, no margins, no rotation, no mirroring, no rearrangement. Original gold/bronze ornaments and handle bands become cold silver steel. Existing silver cutting edges retain bright silver and deep gray definition. The red inner panels, red ribbon areas and red rod wrap become ICE BLUE; dark recesses become restrained midnight blue-gray. Brown leather remains dark cold gray-brown. Retain strong readable material contrast and the exact original engraved patterns. Use the original flat UV layout across the entire canvas; do NOT show a single complete halberd, a render, perspective, character, concept sheet, wireframe or labels. Fully opaque RGB color texture, preserve unused background areas. Output exact 1:2 aspect ratio, ideally 256x512 or another exact 1:2 resolution. Absolutely no square image, no white border, no added background.
output_preparation: Original UV atlas aspect ratios preserved. Generator masters resized using Lanczos to match the original cached texture dimensions; no cropping or color recoloring during preparation.
